channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Iran and Gulf states will meet to secure deal for Strait of Hormuz shipping — FT
item.description: Iran and Gulf states are set to hold a meeting aimed at securing buy-in for a temporary deal to manage shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, the Financial Times reported on Friday.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Softens to near 179.00, bearish bias remains intact below 100-day SMA
item.description: The EUR/JPY cross trades in negative territory around 179.10 during the early European session on Friday. The expectation of a Bank of Japan (BoJ) rate hike next week provides some support to the Japanese Yen (JPY) against the Euro (EUR).

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Friday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Asian Stocks decline as surging oil prices stoke inflation fears and lift Fed hike bets
item.description: Asian stocks declined sharply on Friday, tracking the overnight fall on Wall Street, as a surge in energy prices and a global bond selloff trigger the broader risk-off move.

item.title: Swiss Franc declines as US Dollar strengthens on rising Fed hike bets
item.description: USD/CHF gains ground for the third consecutive day, trading around 0.8140 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) gains ground as expectations grow for a Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike in September.

item.title: Gold eyes $4,300 break as USD sticks to gains amid Fed hike bets, ahead of US CPI
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to register any meaningful recovery and languishes near a one-and-a-half-week low, touched during the Asian session on Friday.

item.title: United States Dollar Index holds onto gains above 99 ahead of US CPI data
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) clings to its Thursday gains in early session on Friday, driven by faster-than-expected growth in the United States (US) Producer Price Index (PPI) data for August.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD slips below $63.50 amid rising Fed rate hike odds
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around $63.30 per troy ounce during Asian hours on Friday. Silver prices are declining as expectations grow for a Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike in September.

item.title: BoJ set to raise interest rates by 25 bps next week - Reuters
item.description: According to a Reuters report, sources say that the Bank of Japan (BoJ) is set to raise interest rates, most likely by 25 basis points, at the policy meeting on September 18. This move will push interest rates higher to 1.25%, a level not seen in the last 31 years.

item.title: Australian Dollar softens to near 0.7150, US CPI inflation data looms
item.description: The AUD/USD pair edges lower to around 0.7155 during the early Asian session on Friday. The US Dollar strengthens against the Australian Dollar (AUD) following signs of hotter inflation in the United States (US).

item.title: Japan’s Katayama says to maintain close communication with US on currency markets
item.description: Japanese Finance Minister (FM) Satsuki Katayama said on Friday that the government will ‌continue to closely communicate with the United States (US) to ensure orderly foreign exchange markets.

item.title: Canadian Dollar struggles as oil prices decline
item.description: USD/CAD extended its gains for the third consecutive day, trading around 1.3840 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) struggles due to lower oil prices.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar recovers from six-week low vs USD; upside seems capped ahead of US CPI
item.description: The NZD/USD pair gains some positive traction during the Asian session on Friday, reversing a part of the previous day's heavy losses to sub-0.5800 levels, or the lowest since late July.

item.title: British Pound holds steady above 1.3500 ahead of US CPI inflation release
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades on a flat note near 1.3510 during the early Asian session on Friday. Traders prefer to wait on the sidelines ahead of the key US August Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation report later on Friday.

item.title: Japanese Yen edges higher as PPI reaffirms BoJ rate hike bets and USD bulls await US CPI
item.description: The USD/JPY pair struggles to capitalize on the previous day's recovery momentum and edges lower during the Asian session on Friday.

item.title: WTI trades near $99.00 after pulling back from nearly four-month highs
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) halts its four-day winning streak, trading around $99.00 per barrel during Asian hours on Friday. However, crude oil prices may rebound as the escalating conflict between the US and Iran has fueled concerns over prolonged disruptions to global energy supplies.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7743 vs. 6.7766 previous
item.description: On Friday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7743 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7766 and 6.7174 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Euro flatlines above 1.1600 despite ECB hawkish hike, traders brace for US CPI data
item.description: The EUR/USD pair holds steady around 1.1610 during the early Asian session on Friday. Traders continue to assess a hawkish hike from the European Central Bank (ECB).

item.title: Australian Dollar slides as US yields jump before pivotal CPI
item.description: The Australian Dollar ended Thursday’s session with a 0.80% loss against the US Dollar after US producer inflation exceeded estimates, triggering pricing for a more hawkish Federal Reserve. The AUD/USD trades at 0.7159 after reaching a peak of 0.7223.

item.title: Gold falls below $4,350 as rising oil prices, US PPI reinforces Fed hike bets
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) tumbles to near $4,320 during the early Asian session on Friday. The precious metal faces some selling pressure after the US Producer Price Index (PPI) inflation data and rising oil prices increased bets for a Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Yen strength keeps 110.00 in sight
item.description: The Australian Dollar weakens versus the Japanese Yen as risk-appetite shifted sour due to the escalation of the US-Iran conflict, which has broadened to a fight between Yemen’s Houthis vs Saudi Arabia, who fight for control of the Red Sea. The AUD/JPY exchange rate is 110.53, down 0.27%.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar steadies after two-month low slide
item.description: NZD/USD is clinging to the 0.5800 mark at the start of the Asian session on Friday after dipping to a near two-month low around 0.5797 earlier in the American session.

item.title: WTI blasts past $100 as Red Sea, Hormuz risks collide
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude Oil benchmark, rises more than 7% as attacks in the Middle East intensify, driving WTI above the $ 100-per-barrel barrier for the first time since May 2026. At the time of writing, WTI trades at $103.86 after bouncing off lows of $95.37.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar rebounds on hot PPI ahead of US CPI
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY) reclaimed the 99.00 barrier and then some, rebounding firmly as the hot Producer Price Index (PPI) rose 5.4% over the year to August, hardening expectations for a Fed rate hike at next week's meeting.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: Head-and-shoulders break puts $60 back in play
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) price erases Wednesday's gains and forms a bearish head-and-shoulders chart pattern on Thursday after the white metal tanks and breaks a support trendline around $64.00-$64.15, exacerbating the decline below $63.50. At the time of writing, XAG/USD trades at $63.72, down over 5.30%.

item.title: Chinese Yuan: Uptrend eyes breakout 6.7000 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann keep a negative stance on USD/CNH around 6.7060, though recent price action has been confined to 6.7033–6.7074. They see current moves as range trading between 6.7030 and 6.7100 intraday.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Kiwi breaks below 0.5800 as bears take control
item.description: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) fails to clear a confluence of key Simple Moving Averages (SMAs) and dives below 0.5800 on Thursday, printing a near two-month low of 0.5797. At the time of writing, NZD/USD is down 0.65% and poised to test lower levels if it closes below 0.5800.

item.title: Malaysia Ringgit: BNM hawkish tilt limits downside – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank notes USD/MYR has risen to 4.07, marking a fourth consecutive session of Ringgit weakness, weighed by foreign portfolio outflows from Malaysian equities.

item.title: WTI Oil nears $100 as Middle East tensions keep supply concerns elevated
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) Oil rallies nearly 5% on Thursday, climbing to its highest level since May 21 as escalating tensions in the Middle East raise fears of further disruption to already tight supplies. At the time of writing, WTI trades around $99 and is up about 10.50% so far this week.

item.title: ECB sources say further tightening remains likely – Reuters
item.description: According to Reuters sources, the European Central Bank (ECB) is expected to further tighten monetary policy in the months ahead and could raise rates in October.
